description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), grants [50% Critical (25s)] to all allies, grants [Attach Water 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Zealous Fighter Mode] to the user

description.name: Attach Water 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Synchro Mode

description.name: Zealous Fighter Mode
